Mechanical Department Placement & Training Cell

The departments vision has been to nurture the students into intellectually capable, innovative professionals who shall contribute to the growth of technology in association with the industries.

The purpose of training and placement is to guide our students to choose right career and give knowledge, skill and aptitude and to meet the manpower requirements of industry. Our main strength lies in academics along with training on life skills (both soft and technical), real world applications of concepts, seminars, internships, presentations, case studies, participation in seminars and conferences, sports and cultural activities.
